Title: Block Member - blocked single-org member authenticates but carries NO organization context
Preconditions:
Logged in as company Admin (Organization maintainer)
A SINGLE-org active member exists whose only membership is this organization (e.g. users.csv USR-007, ORG-002 only - absent from organization-memberships.csv)
NOTE: the member must NOT also be account-locked. An account-locked user fails at /connect/token with 400 user_is_temporary_locked_out BEFORE org resolution runs, which answers a different question.
Steps:
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] log in as company Admin
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/company/members
[ACT] locate the active single-org member
[ACT] open its Actions menu and choose Block user
[WAIT] the confirmation dialog appears
[ACT] confirm the block
[WAIT] the roster refetch completes and the row reads Blocked
[ACT] sign out
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[ACT] sign in as the blocked member
[KEY] capture the POST /connect/token response and decode the access-token claims
[KEY] capture the GetPageContext GraphQL response for this session
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/company/members
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/account/orders
[ACT] sign out, sign back in as company Admin and UNBLOCK the member (Actions then Unblock user), then verify the roster row reads Active again
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] mutation errors[] is empty
[NETWORK] POST /connect/token returns 4xx for blocked member
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS errors
Failure_Signals: The blocked member reaches /company/members or any org-scoped surface; the token still carries organization_id or permission[]; GetPageContext returns a non-null contact.organization; the Corporate sidebar section is still present; /account/orders or /cart break (that is a lost session, not a lost org); the unblock fails to restore the original role
Cleanup: MANDATORY: unblock the member and verify the roster row reads Active with its original role - this fixture is shared and roughly 40 cases across several suites depend on its state
References: Coverage Gap Analysis; REWRITTEN 2026-09-19 from a live probe (REG-2026-09-19-1035). The case previously asserted a 4xx sign-in and listed "blocked member can still log in" as a failure signal; both contradict BL-AUTH-015/016, which state that a grant resolving NO organization succeeds with no org context, and BL-AUTH-012, which separates an org lock from a global lockout. Measured on a single-org member: token without organization_id/permission[], GetPageContext with organizationId/organization null and permissions [], /company/members redirecting to /account/dashboard, Corporate sidebar absent, orders and cart unaffected. SPLIT NOTE: the /403 + ApolloError Access denied expression recorded on 2026-09-09 was measured on a MULTI-ORG user with all memberships locked and an already-live session; that is the same contract in a different UI expression and belongs in its own case, not here. Do NOT assert the org switcher on this fixture - a single-org member has no switcher whether blocked or not. OBSERVATION not filed: contact.organizations.totalCount returns 1 while contact.organization is null. | Behavior:auth.org.resolve.no-org-left
